+---

+- 01M49F8ES2T6QBK5BAPK8SKZ98
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Model: apply the MCP server status reports of the agent to the MCPServerItem of each server'
+---
+## What
+
+ACP v2 alpha.7 has no session update for the status of an MCP server. The FoundationModelsACPAgent session defines an extension message for it. **The shape is defined in the agent task.** Do not start this task until that shape is known; then write the shape here and use the same shape. The agent and the client must use one shape.
+
+After task ^k8skz98, each `MCPServerItem` in `SessionModel.mcpServers` has `status == .notReported`. This task applies each status report of the agent to the item with the same server name.
+
+The route of the report depends on the shape:
+
+- **A `session/update` with an extension kind or an extension `_meta` member.** The update comes through the session subscription into `SessionModel.apply(_:)` and `fold(_:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift:258` and `:276`). Now `SessionMergeEngine` makes an `UnknownEntry` from an unknown kind. Read the report in `fold(_:)` before `engine.apply(_:)`, write it to the item, and do not add a transcript entry for it.
+- **A separate JSON-RPC notification (for example `_fm/mcp_status`).** FoundationModelsACP drops it now: the notification handler of `RoleConnectionCore` (`FoundationModelsACP/Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Connection/RoleConnectionCore.swift:74`) returns for a method that is not in the routing table, and the `Client` protocol has no extension entry point. Then a FoundationModelsACP change must come first, and this card must get a dependency on it. Then route the notification in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ModelClient.swift` to `ConnectionModel.session(for:)`.
+
+Files:
+
+1. `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/MCPServerItem.swift`: add the status cases of the agent to `MCPServerStatus` (for example `.starting`, `.ready`, `.failed(message:)`, as the shape gives them), and an `.unknown(String)` case for a status that this client does not know.
+2. `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel.swift`: add an internal `func applyMCPServerStatus(_ report: …)` that finds the item by name and sets `status`. A report for a name with no item changes nothing and logs one warning.
+3. The route file from the list above (`SessionModel.swift` or `ModelClient.swift`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The card names the exact shape of the agent task before work starts.
+- [ ] A status report changes the `status` of only the item with that name. The other items and `transcript` do not change.
+- [ ] A later report replaces the earlier status.
+- [ ] A status value that the client does not know becomes `.unknown` with the raw value.
+- [ ] A report for a server that is not in `mcpServers` changes nothing and logs one warning.
+- [ ] A report that arrives during a resume replay applies too.
+
+## Tests
+
+- Add `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/SessionModelMCPServerStatusTests.swift`. Use `SessionModelFixtures` and `FakeSessionRequestSender` for the fold path, or `ScriptedStubAgent` scripts for the wire path. No sleeps.
+  - `aStatusReportSetsTheStatusOfItsServer`
+  - `aLaterReportReplacesTheStatus`
+  - `anUnknownStatusIsKeptRaw`
+  - `aReportForAnUnknownServerChangesNothing`
+  - `aStatusReportAddsNoTranscriptEntry`
+- Command: `swift test --filter SessionModelMCPServerStatusTests`, then `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+
+Use /tdd — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+## Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Get the message shape from the agent task, and write it in this card.
+- [ ] Write the five failing tests.
+- [ ] Add the status cases to `MCPServerStatus`.
+- [ ] Add `applyMCPServerStatus(_:)` and the route of the report.
